images.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: provided architectural house render, entrance view. Transform its dated computer-game-like rendering into a convincingly photographic architectural visualization, while locking exact camera framing, perspective, silhouette and ALL architectural geometry. This is the same planned German home, not a redesign. Preserve positions proportions and counts of every window, skylight, door, roof tile courses, gable, chimney, garage, projection, parapet and narrow dark base strip. Especially preserve recessed entrance wall and its horizontal overhang, front large-window projection and narrow side return, separate corner-wrapping box at far left with recessed wall between the two projections. Keep the original warm pale peach plaster, orange-red clay roof tiles, dark window frames, anthracite base, grey garage door; no new color scheme. Improve only material and lighting realism: delicate mineral plaster microtexture, subtle natural variation in clay tiles, physically plausible reflected sky in windows, soft ambient bounce light in shadowed recesses, realistic shadow contact at wall bases, naturally textured paving and grass, believable trees and leaves instead of repetitive CAD assets. Keep same daytime sun direction and broad shadow positions. Keep all people, bench, car, plants and landscape in same positions and scale; render them more naturally without adding or removing objects. Natural professional architectural photograph, controlled neutral white balance, restrained saturation, realistic dynamic range, crisp but not oversharpened. Do not make cinematic sunset, mist, dramatic sky or shallow depth of field. Preserve source aspect ratio 1507:885 and pixel alignment as closely as possible; no crop, no pan, no zoom, no widening of walls. No text, numbers or overlays. Architecture fidelity has priority over visual beautification.

Make image 1 look like a natural professional architectural photograph. Preserve its exact framing, camera angle, perspective, house silhouette, facade divisions, every opening's count/location/size, roof shape, all projecting wall volumes and their separation. No redesign. Keep warm pale peach mineral plaster, orange-red clay roof tiles, dark window frames, anthracite base strip, original paving and landscaping layout. Add fine restrained mineral plaster microtexture, natural clay variation, plausible glazing reflections, soft reflected ambient light and realistic contact shadows; improve grass and plant realism without changing positions. Keep source sunlight direction and broad shadow placement; controlled neutral white balance, believable daytime dynamic range, restrained saturation. Preserve people, furniture and objects in original positions and scale. No crop, zoom, added structures, new windows, removed windows, fancy lighting, sunset, blur, text or annotation. Pixel alignment and architecture fidelity take priority over beautification. Specific garden view: preserve the big main gable at left, broad central wall dormer with its two tall upstairs windows and tall garden doors below, full-height dormer bay, shallow dormer roof between two steep tiled roof sections, flat-roof garage volume at far left with single dark pedestrian door, separate ground-floor corner box at right. Keep all garden furniture including red-cushioned pallet sofa and seated woman, table with yellow chairs and purple planter, blue umbrella, standing man, and white planter with wood top. Preserve source aspect ratio 1549:969. Do not add skylights visible only on the entrance-side roof.
